paragraphs.source_en: She now understood more deeply the Taikō's deathbed lament over life's dreamlike transience. paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi could conduct affairs of state with effortless fluency wherever he happened to be, but for Ieyasu the same task was harder than climbing to heaven.
